source_section.parent_heading: ## A. Blocking the unconditional 2D upper theorem

status_source.quote: B4.rem is CLOSED by B4LOC-R1 for the O(r³) validity grade (register note §2); frozen v2.2: OPEN
status_source.note: claims/graph.json records status_frozen_v2_2 OPEN and status_register_note CLOSED for this premise: B4LOC-R1 closed the dam line and the register note adjudicates the wrap/remote reconciliation YES (§2; B4.rem listed CLOSED in §5), effective at the next issuance; frozen v2.2 still names the premise until then. The layers are not collapsed, and this lane carries the frozen layer's OPEN. Until 2026-09-19 it said the reconciliation 'remains open per the capsule'.

next_exact_action: Nothing on the 2D side beyond issuance: the note layer adjudicates the reconciliation YES; the frozen layer stays OPEN until an operator promotes v2.3. No repository action closes it.
inputs_note: engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json did not exist when this lane file was written (engine/carriers/ is owned elsewhere in this repository), so no carrier_id is bound here. tools/lanes_check.py validates every id in `inputs` against that manifest as soon as the manifest exists.

not_a_substitute.quote: `B4LOC-R1` closed the dam line for the whole of B4 and resolved the identification negatively (cut-net ≢ nine-pin tube).
not_a_substitute.reading: Transcribed context. The closure is of the dam line; it is not a closure of the wrap/remote reconciliation, which is what this lane is.

repo_state_note: No dam-line or wrap/remote computation exists in this repository. `repo_state` describes only what code exists in this repository. It is not a mathematical status and no verdict, promotion or discharge may be read from it.
does_not_establish: This lane does not reconcile wrap with remote, does not re-open or re-close the dam line, and does not carry the register-note CLOSED status over to the frozen layer.
